items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started taking classical guitar lessons from Vicente Gomez in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: And… oh, and then I started taking classical guitar lessons from Vicente Gomez in Los Angeles. He was great. I can’t play classic guitar at all now but… He, he was, he was from Mexico and he had written… I don’t think he did the scores but he wrote some music for, for some Hispanic films occasionally.
